topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment while setting out the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages to drive Darwinian clonal selection.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the relationship between normal tissue hierarchies and cancer development through experimental evidence for cancer stem cells in leukemias and solid tumors.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Influences, Analytical Methods, and Cancer Evolution Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments drive tumor progression, present analytical methods to study these cellular interactions, and synthesize the evolutionary mechanisms of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It formally concludes the lecture and previews the topic of the next session.
